rows.en: The "Memory Memory," the Core Medals, Regis... When they are one, the "Ultimate Being" is born...
Heh heh heh heh heh heh...
A warrior who fights fueled by dark hearts. The negative emotions you heroes secretly harbor...
In other words, I am the one who turns Minus Energy into the power of hatred...
With the power of Kamen Rider Core, I shall send you all to your graves!!
C-Curse you... Mere Lost Heroes... I will show you no more mercy!!
You will all be wiped out!! Leaving behind only your fear, your agony and your hatred!!!
What the hell is this thing...!!
I am the strongest and most wicked of all, the Hundred Monster Beryudora!!!
The monsters sleeping in the Monster Graveyard are now one, thanks to Regis's power!!
No matter how much power of justice you gather, it's far too brittle to even be worth talking about!!
What will unite all the worlds into one and rule them is the absolute power of evil!!
Now learn it the hard way!!
That's not true!! There's no way the power of evil is absolute!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's dead wrong. Your so-called power of evil... it ain't nothin' but a big fake!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!

That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!

That's not true!! The power of evil is nothing but a sham!!
I'll prove it to you right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove it right now!! With your defeat!!
I'm gonna prove it right now!! By makin' you lose!!
Then I shall prove it right now!! Through your defeat!!

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0736.bla (key #0.N = MessWinSet TextIdOffset+(N-1)). Regis's archaic 'when they become one' kept grand. 'Memory Memory' and 'Ultimate Being' quoted as established in story_146+.
Script labels this ??? (name id 30); it is Kamen Rider Core before the reveal. Laugh rendered 'Heh heh...' as in the recent 0731/0733 slices.

Block #190-204 = TextIdOffset+189+index, spoken by the 2nd party member if present (else the leader); index from the Pt_Chara_Check chain before Regis #163 (God Gundam, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, Den-O, Black RX, Rider 1, OOO, W). All identical Japanese, identical English.
Script gives this to Kamen Rider Core (name id 231): his answer to 'Y-You're...!!', announcing himself. Kept as a bare name shout.

Core's self-description runs across #206-207; the second sentence of #206 (the heroes' hidden negative emotions) is glossed by 'in other words, Minus Energy' in #207. Restored 'I am' in #207 (pro-drop). 'Heroes' carries a contemptuous plural suffix; rendered 'you heroes'.
Regis (id 228), #213-214 confirmed. Trailing 'mere Lost Heroes...' left unfinished as in the source.
Only #215 is played: MessWinSetED TextIdOffset+214 with the leader's name and no index. #216-229 are never referenced; identical Japanese, identical English.

Block #232-246 = TextIdOffset+231+index (2nd member if present), chain after battle 571: OOO, W, Den-O, Black RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Zeta, Nu. Identical lines.

Beryudora (id 230) for #248-253 confirmed. Title rendered 'Hundred Monster' (Ultraman Wiki English for this monster title); 'monster' follows the project's title style (Monster Chief, Volcano Monster Bird). Not in glossary terms.
The source says just 'the graveyard'; rendered 'Monster Graveyard' (glossary term) since that is the referent.

Blocks #254-268 and #270-284 are NEVER played: after battle 572 the script goes straight to TextIdOffset+285+index (#286-300). Voiced by the post-571 chain order, which the wording confirms: #254 OOO (distinct wording), #255 W, #256 Den-O (Momotaros: rough slang), #257 Black RX, #258 Rider 1, #259 Zero, #260 Mebius, #261 Taro, #262 Seven, #263 Ultraman, #264 00, #265 Wing Zero, #266 God Gundam, #267 Zeta, #268 Nu.

Same unplayed second block: #270 OOO (casual), #271 W, #272 Den-O (Momotaros: crude 'you' form), #273 Black RX (formal 'shall', contemptuous 'you'). Subject 'I' restored; source uses singular first-person verb forms.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified in 0736.bla; extracted labels correct. Unplayed blocks #216-229, #254-268, #270-273 translated anyway (variant order from the post-571 chain, matched by wording). Not in glossary: 'Hundred Monster' (Beryudora's title).
